title: Finite Tor amplitude of a module model on an affine open
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open and R = Gamma(U,O_S). Let K in D(O_S) [def-pc-derived-category] have finite Tor dimension [def-pc-finite-tor-dimension]. Let P be any complex of R-modules whose image under the explicit affine sheafification functor F_U [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model] represents the restriction of K to the localized site over U. Then there exist integers a <= b such that Q(P) has Tor amplitude in [a,b] over R: for every R-module N, H^i(Q(P) tensor_R^L N) = 0 for i outside [a,b]. No pseudo-coherence or boundedness of P is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08E9(1), combined with Cohomology of Sheaves Tag 08CG and Derived Categories of Schemes Tag 08DX(2)

proof.text: Unpack HasFiniteTorDimension to obtain a <= b and the global tensor cohomology vanishing for every test sheaf. Choose HasDerivedCategory.standard for spectrum sheaves at universe u+1; the module localization remains the one supplied in the original signature.

For any spectrum module sheaf G and degree i outside [a,b], specialize the global vanishing to the actual sheaf (Modules.pushforward (isoSpec.inv followed by U.ι)).obj G. Apply affine_sheafification_tensor_vanishing_test to obtain the degree-i vanishing for Q(tilde P) against G. This combines locality and affine-site transport from the original first two steps, without changing the interval.
Apply the forward implication of affine_torAmplitude_iff to this sheaf-side fixed-interval vanishing. Keep a, b and a<=b as the existential witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Part (1), after pointwise direct-image transfer from the original locality and transport steps; Lean reduction by R1, 2026-10-13

lean.statement: theorem finiteTorAmplitude_of_affine_sheafification (S : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))] [∀ V : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over V))] (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ModuleCat.{u} (S.presheaf.obj (.op U)))] (K : schemeDerivedCategory S) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (S.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ) (hP : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((affinePerfectSheafification S U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) (hTor : HasFiniteTorDimension S K) : ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u} (S.presheaf.obj (.op U))) a b (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
